# API Template

Version: 0.1.0  
Status: Template  
Last Updated: 2026-07-27

## API Name

Name of the API or adapter.

## Purpose

Describe what this API is responsible for.

## Authentication

Describe authentication and secret handling.

## Endpoints or Methods

List endpoints or interface methods.

## Request Contract

Describe request fields and validation.

## Response Contract

Describe response fields and normalization.

## Errors

Define error codes, retry behavior, and fail-safe handling.

## Rate Limits

Describe known limits and throttling policy.

## Tests

Define integration and contract tests.
